import re


def _installed(world, M, X):
    r = world.run(M, "ollama", "list")
    if r.rc != 0:
        raise RuntimeError("could not list models on %s: %s" % (M, (r.err or r.out).strip()))
    names = []
    for i, line in enumerate(r.out.splitlines()):
        line = line.strip()
        if not line:
            continue
        parts = re.split(r"\s+", line)
        if i == 0 and parts[0].upper() == "NAME":
            continue
        names.append(parts[0])
    want = X.strip()
    for n in names:
        if n == want:
            return True
        if ":" not in want and n.split(":")[0] == want:
            return True
    return False


def install(world, M, X):
    """Make true: "{X} is installed on {M}"."""
    if M not in world.machines():
        raise RuntimeError("unknown machine: %s" % M)
    if _installed(world, M, X):
        return "%s is already installed on %s" % (X, M)
    r = world.run(M, "ollama", "pull", X)
    if r.rc != 0:
        raise RuntimeError("could not install %s on %s: %s" % (X, M, (r.err or r.out).strip()))
    if not _installed(world, M, X):
        raise RuntimeError("%s not found on %s after pull" % (X, M))
    return "Done: %s is installed on %s" % (X, M)
